dedupe_keys.name: ncc broadcast transmitter and radio monitoring station locations fm am and digital tv transmitters taiwan

description: Taiwan's National Communications Commission publishes the locations of broadcast transmitters as open data. The FM table gives, for each FM radio station, its name, frequency in MHz, transmitter address, longitude and latitude, and station class (national, regional or community). An AM table gives the same fields in kHz and was last updated in April 2026. A list of digital terrestrial television transmitters gives the operating company, station name, county and township for 127 transmitters. A separate list of digital TV gap-filler stations and the fixed radio monitoring stations of the commission (21 stations with WGS-84 coordinates and addresses) complete the picture. Registers of radio and television broadcasters, their licences and enforcement actions are also published. Coverage: Taiwan, including outlying islands. Format and access: XLS (FM and AM) and CSV (TV and monitoring stations), free under the Open Government Data License. Caveats: TV transmitters are located to township, not coordinates; transmitter power, antenna height and coverage contours are not included; the NCC file server refused automated requests from this environment, so the files were not checked. Simulation uses: broadcast transmitter exposure to typhoon wind, landslide and earthquake hazards, and alternative public warning channels when mobile networks fail. Related records: the FCC LMS and CDBS broadcast station databases and the Norway FM switch-off case study give comparable broadcast infrastructure information.
name: NCC broadcast transmitter and radio monitoring station locations: FM, AM and digital TV transmitters (Taiwan)
notes: Metadata read from the data.gov.tw catalogue export on 2026-09-26 (datasets 6445, 6446, 95107, 95159, 6825; fields, update dates, licence). Station counts for FM and AM were not stated. Files on api.ncc.gov.tw returned 403 to curl.
size: 127 TV transmitters; 21 monitoring stations; FM and AM tables
